description: Estimate the real monthly + multi-year cost of AI for a business, and whether to use the cloud, own a private on-prem box, or run the recommended hybrid (box + a lean cloud sub). Use WHENEVER someone asks what AI would cost, whether to buy their own hardware/server/GPU, 'own vs rent', 'is a private box worth it', how much per month/year, or 'what AI setup/hardware should we get'. Give the team as a MIX: power (all-day heavy/agentic), medium (daily bounded), light (occasional) — or pass an industry `preset` (see altronis_ai_cost_presets). Returns cloud cost (with a budget->frontier range), box capex + running cost, the hybrid monthly, the breakeven month, and a plain-English recommendation — all in SGD, on live model prices. Directional planning estimate, not a quote. Same engine as the calculator at altronis.sg/tools/tco.

bizMix.description: Optional percentage mix of the work: general, support, dev, legal, sales, delivery (should sum to ~100).

medium.description: Medium users: daily but bounded use.

mode.description: 'api' = pay-per-token API pricing (default), 'seat' = per-person monthly subscriptions.

model.description: Specific cloud model to price against (e.g. 'Claude Sonnet 5.5', 'GPT-6 Astra'). Default: a mainstream capable model, with budget + frontier options shown for range.

plan.description: Specific subscription plan name when mode='seat'.

power.description: Power users: all-day heavy/agentic use (coding, deep research).

preset.description: Industry/company-type id from altronis_ai_cost_presets (e.g. 'law-firm', 'software-startup', 'solopreneur'). Fills the user mix when power/medium/light are omitted.

name: altronis_ai_cost_estimate
